taste:
This is a clean, crisp vodka and mixer, with a smooth, neutral spirit base rather than a strongly defined vodka flavour. The single measure of Smirnoff Red gives the drink its foundation, while your chosen draught mixer supplies most of its character. Cola and lemonade are examples in the description, so the experience depends on which you order.

Served over a generous handful of ice, it is a straightforward, refreshing drink without an elaborate combination of ingredients. Its appeal lies in that simplicity: choose a mixer you already enjoy rather than expecting a distinctive flavour from the vodka itself. For someone who likes a familiar spirit and mixer, that makes the order easy to judge.
